title: Niobia takes the guesswork out of some of tech's most expensive mistakes | TechCrunch
summary: Niobia’s agents run on open source models that the company trains further with battery and chip research and other data. Niobia, for instance, lets its customers hold their own encryption keys so that the startup cannot decrypt the customers’ data.
